newsitem.title: DUBAI: More than half of Iran's prisoners on drugs charges.
newsitem.headline: More than half of Iran's prisoners on drugs charges.

text.p: Nearly six out of every 10 convicts held in Iranian jails are drugs criminals, the head of the country's prisons organisation said in remarks published in Tehran on Monday.
Assadollah Lajevardi gave the total number of prisoners as 138,000 and said 58 percent were on drugs-related offences.
He said in remarks reported by Kayhan newspaper that 6,750 of the prisoners were aliens, most of them Afghans, and 3,275 of the foreigners were sentenced for drugs-related crimes.

Lajevardi said that in the last year 106,000 people were jailed on drugs charges including addiction, dealing, possession and transportation or cooperation with drug networks. Most were retail distributors.
He said prison authorities had been asked to change prison cultural areas into accommodation to ease congestion and new jails were being built.
